description: Inserts plain text at an index (UTF-16 code units; body content starts at index 1 — get indexes from read_document_text). Omit index to append at the end of the body (or of the segment when segment_id is set). Newlines in the text create new paragraphs; the text inherits the style at the insertion point — style it afterwards with style_text/style_paragraph. Every insert shifts all later indexes, so when making several edits, apply them from the END of the document backwards or re-read between edits. Returns the batchUpdate reply with the new revisionId.

document_id.description: The document id — the long id from the document URL (docs.google.com/document/d/<documentId>/edit) or from create_document output.

index.description: Insertion index (from read_document_text). Omit to append at the end.

segment_id.description: Header/footer/footnote segment id (from get_document). Omit for the document body.

tab_id.description: Tab to target (from list_tabs). Omit for the first/only tab.

text.description: The text to insert; \n starts a new paragraph.

name: insert_text
title: Insert text
